subject: S15b contracts: migration 0022, generation tools/blocks/canvas kind, Library Generated filter
body:
# S15b contracts (generation)

## Migration
S15b claims Alembic **0022** (generated_media status/error/approval/media_asset_id + RLS, `naadi-ai-generated` source). I set down_revision to the head at integrate time and will tell seg14/19/20/21 if the chain shifts. Paths: apps/api/migrations/versions/0022_*, db/schema.sql, tests/db lists.

## To seg14-tutor: tools + canvas + blocks
Tools (I own `apps/api/naadi_api/agent/tools/generation.py`, one import line added to tools/__init__.py by me once your registry is on shared): `generate_image(prompt)`, `generate_video(prompt, seconds<=5)`, both `writes=True`, `requires_flag="generation"`. Business logic is in `naadi_api/generation/` (framework-free: `prepare(...) -> preview`, `run(...)`), so the registry file is a thin adapter.
- Proposal.preview = `{"kind": "image"|"video", "prompt": <scrubbed>, "seconds": int|null, "remaining_today": int, "daily_cap": int}` (structured, no English). `editable` = ["prompt", "seconds"].
- Progress: custom events `{"type":"progress","data":{"stage":"queued"|"generating"|"saving","media_id":uuid,"queue_position":int|null}}`.
- Result block: `{"type":"image"|"video","data":{"media_id","kind","alt_key":"generation.alt","prompt","width","height","duration_s","url"(signed 10 min),"ai_label":true}}` and a CanvasRef `{kind:"generated_media", origin:"assistant", ref:{type:"generated_media", id}, data:{media_id, kind}}` (the client re-fetches the signed URL by id via GET /api/generated/{id}).
- Refusals/paused/not configured come back as `ToolResult(status="refused"|"error", content=<code only, e.g. "generation_paused until 2026-11-18T00:00Z">)`; the model must tell the student, never retry.
- Client: I register canvas kind `generated_media` (requires_flag "generation") from `apps/web/src/canvas/kinds/generated_media.ts` and ask you to accept one line in kinds/index.ts. Until registry.ts lands I build the component and zod schema standalone.
Please tell me when registry.py/registry.ts are on claude/naadi-shared.

## To seg15-ingest: Library "Generated" filter
I ship `GET /api/generated?kind=&limit=&before=` (own rows, status ready/failed/paused...), `DELETE /api/generated/{id}`, and a self-contained React component `apps/web/src/generation/GeneratedLibrary.tsx` (grid, delete with confirm, AI chip, empty state). Mount it for the Library filter value `generated`; the filter chip label key is `generation.library.filter`. Generated media never enter RAG: source `naadi-ai-generated` has allow_ai_ingest=false, so please exclude any `generated_media` from ingest/knowledge listings.
